title: The Inner House
description: For this home in Sunder Vihar, we focused on creating a warm, minimal environment shaped by comfort, clarity, and everyday functionality.A soft palette of warm whites, muted beiges, and natural wood tones forms the foundation of the home. Herringbone wooden flooring introduces subtle movement, while diffused lighting and sheer curtains soften the interiors.
details: Clean lines, gentle curves, and integrated furniture maintain visual continuity without making the spaces feel rigid or overly designed.The bedroom is conceived as a quiet retreat, with ambient cove lighting and a curved chaise adding softness and character. A minimal floating workspace extends naturally within the room, keeping the composition light and functional.
